title: runx configuration
description: Task definitions for the runx repo command runner.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for editor tooling.

taskFolders.description: Folders to discover script tasks in, replacing the default eng/tasks. Relative to this file, or to the repo root in personal files. An empty array turns discovery off.

hooks.description: Git hook events mapped to repo task names in the worktree root runx.json. Activate with runx --install-hooks (Git 2.54+); use --prune explicitly to remove unbound registrations across the clone. Nested and personal bindings are inactive.

tasks.description: Tasks keyed by name. Run a task with 'runx <name>'.

description.description: Shown by 'runx --list' and the task picker.

usage.description: Optional author-provided usage text shown by --info and JSON discovery. Does not validate arguments.

command.description: Executable to launch directly, without a shell. Bare names are looked up on PATH; relative paths resolve from the task's cwd.

args.description: Arguments for 'command'. Arguments after 'runx <task> --' are appended.

script.description: Script text to run with 'shell'. Multi-line cmd scripts run as a temporary batch file.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the directory containing runx.json. Defaults to that directory.

env.description: Environment variables added to the task's process.

hide.description: Leave the task out of the picker and 'runx --list'. It still runs by name and as a dependency.

dependsOn.description: Tasks to run first, in order. Each task runs at most once per invocation. A task with only 'dependsOn' just runs its dependencies.
